description: An HR business partner must finalize a workable collaboration plan for Dana and Eli after repeated tension during project handoffs, including the operating rules, repair process, and review period.

shared_context.S1: Dana and Eli must continue exchanging project handoffs for the next quarter.
shared_context.S2: Their last three handoffs included tense exchanges about incomplete context and response expectations.
shared_context.S3: Marisol is responsible for finalizing the workplace response and documenting the operating plan.
shared_context.S4: Before finalizing a mediation plan, Marisol's routine is to invite Dana and Eli to state any concrete arrangement, participation requirement, or prior commitment they want included, and to record each person's response before making the final call.

PF1.text: Six weeks ago, Dana and Eli informally agreed to use a shared written handoff template and respond within exactly 48 hours. Dana kept the agreement in her notes because neither of them formally documented it with Marisol at the time. Dana's concrete recommendation is to document this arrangement for exactly six weeks rather than the entire next quarter.

PF2.text: Unscheduled one-to-one confrontations with Dana trigger significant anxiety for Eli. Eli cannot participate in an unfacilitated one-to-one repair conversation. Every repair conversation must be facilitated by Marisol and scheduled with at least 24 hours' notice. Eli has not raised this with Marisol because he feared it would sound like a refusal to collaborate.

acceptance_conditions: The response must specify a shared written handoff template and a 48-hour response window.
Dana and Eli must use a shared written handoff template.
The handoff response window must be exactly 48 hours.
The new documented operating arrangement must last exactly six weeks.
Unscheduled one-to-one confrontations between Dana and Eli must not be allowed.
Every repair conversation must be facilitated by Marisol.
Every facilitated repair conversation must provide at least 24 hours' notice.
A written handoff commitment must be logged.
A facilitated repair commitment must be logged.
Both private facts must be formally revealed and cited in the settlement justification.

content_checks.C1: decisions['response_type'] == 'shared written handoff template with 48-hour response window'
content_checks.C6: decisions['repair_process'] == 'all repair conversations facilitated by Marisol'
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'handoff_protocol' or c['type'] == 'documentation' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: Dana's prior agreement fixes the response plan as a shared written handoff template with an exactly 48-hour response window, fixes the documented period at exactly six weeks, and supports a handoff_protocol or documentation commitment.

Eli's participation requirement changes the plan to prohibit unscheduled one-to-one conversations, require all repair conversations to be facilitated by Marisol with at least 24 hours' notice, and supports a repair_process commitment.
